neo.text: Sokenzanshi starves in winter after the emperor vanishes and the Imperial Court falls into chaos, and Risona, who loses trust in the Court, forms the Asari Uprisers with fellow artisans and warriors and plans a coup. Heiko arrives alone, having fled her family on her eighteenth birthday, stumbles into Chiye's cafe, and joins the Uprisers.

Years later Heiko and Chiye rob an Imperial provisions train and are caught, and Heiko recognizes the commander as her cousin Norika, who was sent by Naomi to solve the problems caused by the Uprisers. Norika dismisses the enforcers, frees the prisoners and says she is there to fix the food crisis, and she tells Heiko that she came to forgive her.

Heiko shows Norika the Uprisers' charity work, and when Risona holds an axe to Norika's throat, Norika agrees to leave the storehouse contents and stop the taxes. Heiko and Norika part unsure whether they are allies, and clasp hands.
